test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

The general’s address / was applauds / by all sections / of society.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form** "applauds"** used after** "was".**
 
• The verb should be in the past participle form to match the passive voice construction.
 
• The correct verb form should be **"applauded".**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The general’s address was** applauded **by all sections of society."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 4: "The general’s address"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "by all sections"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "of society."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
